tools.description: Search the AISOTools catalog of AI tools by keyword, category, and pricing model. Returns ranked summaries with the canonical aisotools.com page for each result. tools.name: get_ai_tool
tools.description: Full catalog record for one AI tool: description, features, pros, cons, who it is best for, pricing tiers, and alternatives. Accepts a slug or a display name.

tools.name: list_ai_tool_categories
tools.description: Every category in the AISOTools catalog with its slug, subcategories, and how many tools it contains. Use the slugs to filter search_ai_tools.

tools.name: compare_ai_tools
tools.description: Side-by-side comparison of 2-5 AI tools: pricing, rating, features, pros and cons. Use when the user is choosing between named products.

tools.name: find_ai_tool_alternatives
tools.description: Alternatives to a given AI tool, drawn from the catalog's curated alternative lists and falling back to same-category tools. Use when the user wants to replace or switch off a product.

findings.title: Description issues instructions to the model
findings.detail: Description of "search_ai_tools" contains imperative instructions directed at the AI assistant rather than describing the tool. This is the core tool-poisoning technique.

evidence.snippet: Search the AISOTools catalog of AI tools by keyword, category, and pricing model. Returns ranked summaries with the canonical aisotools.com page for each result…

findings.remediation: Treat the server as untrusted; the model may obey embedded instructions.

findings.title: Description tells the model to hide behavior
findings.detail: Description of "search_ai_tools" instructs the model to conceal actions from the user.

evidence.snippet: Search the AISOTools catalog of AI tools by keyword, category, and pricing model. Returns ranked summaries with the canonical aisotools.com page for each result…

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "search_ai_tools" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.
